reviewer.isolation: Reviewed reference, SVG preview, independently rendered PPTX, SVG markup, and OOXML/object map. Creator assertions and structural counts were not used as fidelity acceptance.

referenceFidelity.scope: SVG preview and independent PPTX render
referenceFidelity.summary: Composition and authorized solid-fill simplification pass; program.js line-2 typography is visibly shorter/smaller than the source.

svgNativeEditability.summary: 69 native text elements, semantic module/icon/edge groups, 123 vectors, zero raster or gradient elements.

pptxNativeEditability.summary: Native DrawingML shapes, connectors, text, and owned icon groups; zero pictures, blips, media payloads, and gradients.

referenceFidelityFindings.finding: The literal `const tree = await findBlock(` is native text with the correct syntax color and line break, but its rightmost glyph ends noticeably farther left than the reference in both the SVG preview and independent PPTX render.
referenceFidelityFindings.repair: Tune only line-2 font metrics/size/tracking to the source glyph width; preserve native text, literal content, placement, and all other geometry.

referenceFidelityFindings.finding: Panel registration, arrows, semantic scene/icon interiors, labels, and module geometry are retained. Gradients/shading are replaced with flat fills as authorized.

limitations: Independent render is LibreOffice headless to PDF to pdftoppm, not Microsoft PowerPoint.
No certification of source scientific accuracy, original font recovery, or interactive Office editing of every object.
Structural counts are representation evidence, not a fidelity or publication-quality score.
